hero.title: File:Atik Ali Pasha Mosque 6235.jpg
hero.description: The mosque is one of the oldest in town, being built in 1496 by the Hadım (Eunuch) Atik Ali Paşa who was a Grand Vezir of Sultan Beyazit II. The complex has been larger, but was partly destroyed when the main road nearby was constructed. However, the mosque still sits in a quiet courtyard. It differs from similar mosques in that the central rectangular space consists of a large room covered with a dome, and a continuation where, in the East, the mihrab is situated. The first space has to either side two rooms with smaller domes. The stalactite pendentives are well proportioned and fine.
